events.about:
A workshop led by Wissam Kotait, examines the contemporary position of psychoanalysis within a clinical culture increasingly shaped by demands for efficiency, measurable outcomes, and rapid solutions.

Participants will engage in critical reflection on psychodynamics today, the roles of analyst and analysand, and the ethical and political dimensions of psychoanalytic practice.

The workshop emphasizes clinical thinking and reflection rather than techniques or ready-to-use tools.
events.title: Being a Psychoanalyst in 2026
